# `scripts/post-process/ConvertToFITS.py`

Source: [ConvertToFITS.py](../../../../scripts/post-process/ConvertToFITS.py)

Convert Rockstar / consistent-trees text outputs to FITS tables (the first FITS converter; the
pipeline now uses `compress_halo_outputs.py`).

## Contents

- [`parse_header`](#parse_header) - This parse the header to figure out the column names
- [`get_header_dic`](#get_header_dic) - extract the line which has header and file\_type and call the parse header
- [`out_column_list`](#out_column_list) - gives the list of columns to write given the file type
- [`Write2FITS`](#write2fits) - This takes the input data and write the relevant properties to FITS file
- [`convert_fits`](#convert_fits) - converts the ascii halos to fits file
- [`fits_to_record`](#fits_to_record) - converts a fits file to record array keeping only the index You can keep only selected fields by giving a list as list\_sel\_col If the columns needed is spread over mutiple files then fhandle can be a list of fits handels

## parse_header

```python
parse_header(header_line, file_type='trees')
```

This parse the header to figure out the column names

## get_header_dic

```python
get_header_dic(file_name)
```

extract the line which has header and file\_type and call the parse header

## out_column_list

```python
out_column_list(col_dic, output_type='basic')
```

gives the list of columns to write given the file type

## Write2FITS

```python
Write2FITS(dicIN, datain=np.array([]), outfile='', colTokey={})
```

This takes the input data and write the relevant properties to FITS file

## convert_fits

```python
convert_fits(indir='', rootin='', outdir=None, list_output_type=['basic', 'extended', 'vahc'], nlim=1000000)
```

converts the ascii halos to fits file

## fits_to_record

```python
fits_to_record(fhandle, index, list_sel_col=None)
```

converts a fits file to record array keeping only the index
You can keep only selected fields by giving a list as list\_sel\_col
If the columns needed is spread over mutiple files then fhandle can be a list of fits handels
